items.subject: AVX-512VBMI permutation decoder
items.objective: In its own research branch, modify only src/candidate.cpp to evaluate a distinct AVX-512VBMI table-permutation approach for mapping Base64 input bytes to six-bit values, then pack decoded bytes. Do not merely widen T1’s loop: contrast its mapping strategy explicitly. Verify the required instructions are enabled by the frozen build and supported by the target; do not change compiler flags or assume 512-bit execution is faster. Use safe loads/stores and correct tails/padding, preserve exact output semantics, and respect the threads budget. Validate empty and short strings, lengths around vector-block boundaries, every padding case, random valid inputs, and the official Lena input before repeated native timing; record unsupported-ISA and performance failures.

provenance: controller facts and separately labelled model interpretations
